title: Shadow Safety Lab and Rollback Suggester for Silent Rollouts
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description:
Problem: Customers running silent/canary rollouts and shadow traffic today struggle to decide whether to proceed or abort when subtle regressions appear. Current Console diffs show metric deltas but lack a unified signal that combines per-route deltas, trace divergence, and token-level output drift into an actionable safety recommendation.

Goal: Ship a 'Shadow Safety Lab' feature in Console that: 1) consolidates cohort diffs for shadow and canary traffic, 2) surfaces ranked root-cause signals (latency, top-k prediction skew, embedding drift, error classes), and 3) provides a rollback suggestion including confidence and recommended mitigation (partial rollback, throttling, fallback model). The experience should support both manual and semi-automated rollouts (auto-rollback when confidence > threshold).

Scope:
- New Shadow Safety Lab dashboard (per-route summary + cohort diff panel).
- Trace-linked divergence scorer that highlights representative traces tied to metric spikes.
- Signal fusion engine (server-side) that produces a single 'safety score' per variant and per route.
- Rollback Suggester UI: shows top reasons, confidence band, and one-click rollback to previous pinned model or route variant.
- Controls for customers to set auto-rollback policy thresholds and notification channels.

Out of scope for this ticket: full experiment assignment UX redesign, large-scale model introspection tools, and advanced A/B statistical hypothesis testing (we'll surface metric deltas but not run hypothesis tests).

Acceptance criteria:
- Shadow Safety Lab dashboard available under Rollouts -> Variant Health for customers in beta.
- Safety score computed and visible for both shadow and canary cohorts; score provenance (which signals contributed) is explorable.
- Rollback Suggester offers a recommended action with confidence and includes links to the top 3 contributing signals.
- End-to-end test: create a silent rollout with injected latency and top-1/ top-5 response drift; Console surfaces a safety score drop and suggests rollback; clicking rollback triggers the existing rollout revert flow and records an audit event.

Success metrics:
- Beta customers adopt lab during 60% of silent rollouts.
- Time-to-detect actionable regressions reduced by 40% in trials.
- False positive rollback suggestions under 5% in synthetic tests.

High-level design notes:
- Server side: lightweight signal fusion service (stateless aggregator) subscribes to per-route telemetry streams, computes percentile deltas, KL-style embedding drift, and trace divergence heuristics over sliding windows. Each signal is normalized and weighed by route importance and recent traffic volume.
- UI: small multi-panel lab: top-level safety gauge, stacked contributors list, cohort diff heatmap (per-metric and per-percentile), sample traces with linked logs, and an action rail with rollback/hold/escalate.
- Config: customers can opt in to auto-rollback, set confidence thresholds, and choose channels for escalation (Slack/email/PagerDuty webhook).

Trade-offs and alternatives considered:
- Full Bayesian causal test vs. heuristic scoring: we choose heuristic fusion for speed and interpretability; revisit for higher-sensitivity customers later.
- Heavy-weight model-output diffing (token-level alignment) vs. summary statistics: initial phase uses summary stats + representative surface traces to keep compute cost acceptable.

Risks:
- False positives causing unnecessary rollbacks — mitigated by conservative default thresholds and clear undo flows.
- Increased ingestion/compute cost for telemetry — mitigated by sampling and incremental rollout of signal types.

Next steps:
- Finalize weighting scheme with ENG and Research (owner: Marco Nguyen).
- Design mocks and microcopy for safety explanations (owner: Lina Park).
- Implement backend signal fusion prototype and run offline validation on historical rollout data (owner: ENG runtime infra).

acceptance_criteria: Safety score visible and explorable for canary and shadow cohorts
Rollback Suggester provides recommended action with confidence percentage and top 3 contributing signals
Clicking rollback initiates existing revert workflow and creates audit log entry
Performance: safety computation latency under 3s for a typical route snapshot
Documentation: Console help doc and runbook for safety lab published
review_feedback: Design: explainability is crucial; add inline examples of trace-linked divergences
Security: ensure webhook destinations for auto-rollback are whitelisted (SEC-ops)
Engineering: start with sampled telemetry; plan for gradual expansion to full-stream where customers opt in
implementation_notes: Backend component should expose a provenance token per score so the UI can request the contributing signal list
Use existing rollout audit service for recording rollback actions to avoid duplicate storage
